data_not_linked_to_you.description: The subject public record identifier (e.g. PV-GEMREF-001) entered manually or extracted from a scanned QR code is sent to the operator's own PV API server in GET /api/v1/trust/{publicId}/machine, POST /api/v1/actionability, and POST /api/v1/reliance-receipts. This identifier refers to a gemstone/asset record, NOT to the end-user of the app. No user identity, device ID, or advertising ID is attached to these requests.
evidence: lib/core/network/api_client.dart:93 — POST /api/v1/actionability body: {subject_id, purpose_id, requested_action, claim_scope}
lib/core/network/api_client.dart:130 — POST /api/v1/reliance-receipts body: {subject_public_id, purpose_id, requested_action, claim_scope}

data_not_linked_to_you.description: The purpose_id (e.g. 'purchase', 'insurance') and claim_scope are sent with each actionability and reliance-receipt request. These describe the operator's intended use, not personal information.

data_not_collected.evidence: No name field in any model or API payload.
No email field. No user account or login flow in lib/.
No phone field in any model or API payload.
Not collected.
No geolocator import; no LOCATION permission in AndroidManifest.xml; no NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription in Info.plist.
Same as precise location — not collected.
No health API access.
No payment or financial data collected.
Not collected.
No contacts permission in AndroidManifest.xml; no CNContactStore or contacts plugin in pubspec.yaml.
Camera is used for live QR scanning only (mobile_scanner); images are NOT stored or transmitted. Camera frames are processed on-device by mobile_scanner; only the extracted text (publicId) is used.
No microphone usage.
No support chat, ticketing, or feedback feature in the app.
No UGC feature.
No web view or browser history collection.
No ad SDK; no IDFA/GAID access; no tracking domain.
No device_info_plus plugin; no getDeviceId() call; no advertisingIdentifier access. grep lib/ returns zero matches for deviceId, IDFA, GAID.
No Firebase, Sentry, Crashlytics, Bugsnag, or any crash reporting SDK in pubspec.yaml or pubspec.lock.
No analytics or performance monitoring SDK.
No telemetry SDK of any kind.
